answer_text: ‘Vodafone Cash’ in Egypt had 8.2 million active users, with 2.8 million added during the year.
Business deposits of £5.4 billion were roughly 41% of the £13.3 billion total customer balances in FY2024.

Zalando - 2024: KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Berlin (new, first year after EY)
Delivery Hero - 2024: KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Berlin (no evidence on whether new)
Zalando - 2023: EY GmbH & Co. KG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Stuttgart

Yes, both used the same auditor, KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Berlin, for their 2024 financial statements. For Zalando it was new in 2024 (previously EY); the evidence does not state whether it was new for Delivery Hero.
